'''Wor Tandell''' was the primary [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Tandell system]] in the [[Dolomar sector/Legends|Dolomar sector]]. Its surface was covered with an array of [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and landmasses.

==Description==
[[File:Wor_Tandell.jpg|thumb|left|The surface of Wor Tandell.]]
Wor Tandell was located in the Dolomar sector and was part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It was mostly an oceanic and tropical planet with vast [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] located on its surface. The [[Tandreed]] was a native animal of these jungles.

The planet housed many urban settlements as well of which the capital was [[Gantra Lea]]. It served as the primary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and commercial hub of Wor Tandell. Most of its inhabitants were immigrated [[Human/Legends|Humans]].

==History==
In [[3963 BBY]] a Republic [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] ''[[Testament]]'' made a stop on the planet, while [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Telettoh]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Darth Malak|Malak]] were looking for [[Zayne Carrick]] and his band of renegades.<ref name="kotor42" />

[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cuvir]] had a mansion on the planet. While serving as the Governor's personal physician, surgical [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[2-1B/Legends|2-1B]] accompanied Lord Cuvir to his mansion. There, he witnessed Cuvir's assassination at the hands of an aide, secretly working for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. 2-1B accepted the Rebel agent's request to join the Rebellion.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>
